headline: The KSE-100 index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange fell 2,233.79 points or 1.27% to 173,146.07 at 9:40am on Friday as selling returned after days of buying, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Friday subah 9:40 baje index 1.27% neeche aa gaya

caption:
PSX mein bhari selling, KSE-100 2,233.79 points gir gaya!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Friday ko trading ke shuruati minton mein subah 9:40 baje KSE-100 index 2,233.79 points (1.27%) ki kami ke saath 173,146.07 par tha. Thursday ko index 175,379.87 par band hua tha.
Aap ke khayal mein market phir upar jayegi? Comment mein batayein 👇
